extension.description: WebG Booking - appointment booking for Joomla 5/6 with a native YOOtheme Pro element, event types (duration, buffers, Meet or phone call, Stripe payment), email notifications and reminders, Google Calendar/Meet. Installs the booking component, the system plugin and the reminders task plugin together.
